newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Paperboard Q4 shr $0.56 vs $0.41.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Paperboard Q4 shr $0.56 vs $0.41.

text.p: 1) Construction of a cogeneration project in which the company is participating as a steam host has not been completed.

The company has a firm contract with the cogeneration developer to receive a series of cash payments totalling $7,000,000 between May 1995 and May 1997. The present value of these cash payments has been established as a receivable.

2) The company sold its Lewis Mill on March 22, 1995. The net book value of the assets sold was $19,311,000 and total expenses relating to the sale are estimated at $1,781,000. The purchase price for these assets was $12,933,000 resulting in a loss of $8,159,000 before tax. Net of tax benefits this loss will approximate $4,000,000. Additionally, inventory in the amount of $1,080,000 was sold at book value.

3) In April 1994, the company concluded a $25,000,000 sale/leaseback transaction with The CIT Group that resulted in a deferred book gain of $17,200,000. This gain is being recognized over the 10-year life of the lease. Existing NOLs were utilized to offset the taxability of that gain. At the time of the transaction there was some uncertainty as to how this transaction would be dealt with under an IRS review. The company therefore chose to not reflect future tax benefits at this time. The company has continued to review the tax impact and determinations arising from this transaction and has concluded it is appropriate to recognize all deferred tax assets arising from it. The tax benefit being recognized in the third quarter 1995 is $3,000,000.
